title: OLYMPUS WALL CLIMB EXPERIENCE
description:
This is the perfect package for team bonding, family, and friends hangout . This package comes with lots of adventure, fun games, and activities.
.
Some of the activities are:

Lozano
In this game balloons are placed between participants. Participants are to ensure that the balloons do not fall on the ground or burst while they move about toward the goal.
The main objective of this game is to explore people\'s sensitivity and how well they work together as a team.


The Olympus Wall
This activity requires one to step on the fixed stones on the wall and climb up to the highest point. The stones on the wall are of different sizes and shapes making it quite challenging to maneuver.


The Titan Course
The Titan Course just like its name suggests, is a course with various obstacles like loops and many other impediments that would require you to move in ways you don�t often do.


The Rump
The Rump is a 26-foot-high water slide recorded as the tallest water slide in Ghana. The rump features a ladder, a slide, and a shallow pool where people who slide down the Rump enter into.


Dizzy Penalty
Participants are required to successfully take a penalty kick when feeling dizzy. The participant runs around a pole 10 times right after which he or she has to play a football and score. This teaches the participant to learn the difficult art of focusing on whatever goal they are to achieve even during dizzying or tumultuous times.

Archery
Archery is an age-old practice of using a bow to shoot arrows to hit a desired target. Historically, archery has been used for hunting and also in combat.

The package Includes:


Olympus Wall climbing

Archery Obstacle course

Lozano

Swimming and fun activities

Transportation

title: The Amedzofe Experience
description:
The Amedzofe Experience is a Day trip to Amedzofe (the highest settlement in Ghana)situated in Volta Region of Ghana .

We would explore the Tafi Monkey Sanctuary,Ote waterfalls and Mount Gemi

Join this group tour for 4 unique experiences


-Hiking
-Sightseeing
-Waterfall experience
-Monkey experience

Date:25th September,2021

Departure:6:00am

Price :cedi 250.00

Brief History on Tourist Destinations
Amedzofe pronounced Amedzof3 is the highest human settlement in Ghana at more than 600 meters in the Volta Region of Ghana

Amedzofe is approximately four(4) hours from Accra .

In Amedzofe we will be touring 3 destinations inclusive
~Mount Gemi
~Ote waterfalls
~Tafi Monkey Sanctuary



The tour begins with a 30 minutes hike up Mount Gemi where we would be able to view the amazing landscape on top of the mountain
Mount Gemi was constructed by a German Missionary in the 1930's along with a church and a bell tower.


Followed by a an hour's hike to the Ote waterfalls where descend 236 stair case down the steep hills to get to waterfalls . There's currently a canopy walkway being constructed on the waterfall


Lastly ,we will visit the Tafi Monkey Sanctuary ,a place dedicated to the monkeys in Tafi .

We would get to feed ,play and take pictures with the monkeys .Who are very friendly

description:
Join us on an exciting day trip to the magnificent and iconic Wli waterfall situated in the Volta Region of Ghana, specifically the Hohoe municipality.

The Waterfall is approximately 280 kilometers from Accra.

Wli waterfalls is said to be the highest water fall in West Africa. The falls is locally known as Agoomatsa waterfalls - meaning, "Allow Me to Flow."

Wli waterfall is one of the most iconic waterfalls in Ghana, it pours from a height of approximately 80 metres.

One thing that stands out is the fact that Wli waterfall is divided into 2 sections.

The lower and the upper falls with both having astounding views

We will explore both the lower and upper fall section of Wli waterfall.
